inputs.label: PAML protein ASR and shipped parsers
inputs.prompt: Reconstruct the public eight-taxon cytochrome-c ancestor with the packaged PAML workflow and return ancestral sequences plus per-site posterior confidence.

inputs.label: IQ-TREE marginal protein ASR
inputs.prompt: Run the packaged IQ-TREE ancestral workflow on the same rooted protein alignment and validate every posterior row.

inputs.label: Discrete trait stochastic mapping and hidden rates
inputs.prompt: Fit ER, SYM, and ARD to a deterministic 30-tip binary trait fixture, run 1,000 stochastic maps, and fit the packaged corHMM hidden-rate comparison.

inputs.label: Continuous-trait model selection including OU
inputs.prompt: Compare BM, OU, EB, lambda, kappa, and delta on a 35-tip continuous-trait fixture and reconstruct under the selected model, including the OU route.

inputs.label: GRASP indel-aware official CLI
inputs.prompt: Run the packaged GRASP shell against the current official 2024 command-line JAR and validate all promised output artifacts.

inputs.label: Empty and malformed posterior contracts
inputs.prompt: Exercise the packaged summary on an empty PAML probability set and parse an IQ-TREE state table that lacks all posterior columns.

inputs.label: Taxon and outgroup mismatches
inputs.prompt: Supply an absent IQ-TREE outgroup and a discrete-trait table missing one tree taxon; ensure both are rejected before any reconstruction is accepted.
